headline: Tencent sheds 7.3 points in a day yet still sits second at 21.9% share
summary: DeepSeek keeps the top spot, but the big story is Tencent: its provider share fell 7.3 points today while the top two still hold 58.2% between them. Three new entrants landed, led by Tencent's hy4-20261104 at rank 14, and the leaderboard is far from quiet.
highlights: Tencent's provider share dropped 7.3 points in one day to 21.9%, even though it is up 13.7 points over seven days and 15.4 over thirty.
DeepSeek still leads at 36.3% of provider share, and its deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 is the top model with 28.0% of tokens.
DeepSeek and Tencent together hold 58.2%, and the top three (adding Zhipu AI) reach 65.5%.
New entrants: tencent/hy4-20261104 at rank 14, stepfun/step-5-preview-20261008 at rank 25, and thinkingmachines/inkling-2-mini-20261120 at rank 29.
Dropouts included qwen/qwen4-max-20261115, which fell out from rank 26 at 0.5% share, and two lower-ranked models.
